title: S925 Sterling Silver Portuguese Profession Dangle Charm Hollow Letter Pendant Bead For DIY Charm Bracelet Necklace Jewelry Making Gift
body_html: This 925 sterling silver charm pendant is designed to fit most European-style charm bracelets, snake chain bracelets, necklaces, and DIY jewelry chains. Its elegant and versatile style makes it easy to wear alone or mix with other charms. A lovely gift for women, girls, friends, and family on birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, and other special occasions.
